text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. These help team members understand exactly what needs to be done and by when. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must provide. Finally, you should make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the beginning. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
